title: Very Indulgent Algerian Speculaas Tagine
description: A rich and savory Algerian dish featuring speculaas spice mix, made with a bain-marie for a tender and indulgent treat, friendly to egg-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, mix together the speculaas spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spice mix to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the chopped dried apricots, chicken broth, and honey to the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
